name: Sulaki
description: Leopard-like tribe of cat warriors in the Sukurvian Desert who worship Ergerborg.

timeline.summary: Jedit and Adira fly to Efrava, where Jedit's claim to be the first Ojanen is met coldly; he seeks help from other cat tribes and gains the Hooraree and Sulaki.
timeline.quote: he manages to make a tenuous covenant with the Hooraree

citation.text: "Hazezon (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the exodus of the cat warriors, the Scarwood elves claim the forest and fend off tiger-warrior descendants.
timeline.quote: the Scarwood elves would claim the forest as their own

citation.text: "Scarwood", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit tries to unite the cat warrior tribes against Johan; the Sulaki refuse to ally with non-worshippers of Ergerborg.
timeline.quote: the Sulaki first refused to ally with anyone not worshiping Ergerborg

citation.text: "Sulaki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sulaki become the first cat warrior tribe to ally with the humans and Efravans.
timeline.quote: the Sulaki were the first cat warrior tribe to officially ally with the humans and Efravans
